title: Former Fox host Maria Bartiromo sells $6.5M Manhattan townhouse for $7M
summary_full: In a notable real estate transaction, Maria Bartiromo and her spouse, Jonathan Steinberg, finalized the sale of their Manhattan townhouse for a hefty $7 million. This sale occurred confidentially shortly after Bartiromo's departure from Fox News Media, following over 12 years with the network. Having purchased the five-storey residence nearly 19 years ago for $6.5 million, they faced a monetary loss when adjusted for inflation.
